    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = {}
    for row in grid:
        for v in row: counts[v] = counts.get(v, 0) + 1
    bg = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    seeds = [(r,c,v) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v != bg and v != 1]
    for r,c,v in seeds:
        out[r][c] = 4
        for j in range(c-1,-1,-1):
            if grid[r][j] != bg: break
            out[r][j] = v
    return out
''')
